compatibility: buildServer() without identityMode keeps today's behavior: NODE_ENV=test => simulation headers; other environments => per-request 401 without a resolver. No existing test needed a new option.

buildServerFromEnv applies explicit option, then CVG_IDENTITY_MODE, then process env; production always composes trusted. Simulated-env tests under NODE_ENV=test keep working (secretary-bootstrap green).
requireAuthenticatedMutations is forced true only in trusted mode (previously test default could be false); no simulation-mode test changed.
Trusted-mode resolver identities must be tenant-bound; this is new behavior only in explicit/trusted mode.
OperatorIdentityResolver is now exported by @cvg/shared and re-exported by server.ts; the type is structurally identical.
createTrustedOperatorIdentityResolver.secret became optional only when keyRing is provided; existing calls and error messages preserved.
limitations: No real IdP, protocol, audience mapping, provider, secret or egress; D04 remains PENDING and production remains NO-GO.
The resolver port is synchronous; a remote introspection adapter would need an async revision.
main.ts positive composition (with CVG_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_KEYRING) is not exercised against a live database; the negative startup path is exercised by spawning the real entrypoint.

Low-level buildServer in production without a resolver still fails per request (401) instead of throwing at construction, preserving existing production-boundary tests; the startup gate is in buildServerFromEnv/entrypoint.

Routes that resolve identity twice in one request (e.g. capability approvals) would trip the replay cache with real token resolvers; this is pre-existing behavior, unchanged by this lane, flagged for follow-up.
